# Verb + 完 · *Verb + jyun4*

**Meaning:** finish doing · **Level:** A2 · **Topic:** Time and aspect

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fjyun4-finish).

完 after a verb means the action is finished: 做完 (finish doing), 食完 (finish eating). It often comes with 咗 or 喇.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我做完功課喇。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3 laa3. |
| Yale | ngóh jouh yùhn gūng fo la. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄗㄛㄨ⁶ ㄩㄣ⁴ ㄍㄨㄥ¹ ㄈㄛ³ ㄌㄚ³. |
| English | I've finished my homework. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你食完飯未呀？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 sik6 jyun4 faan6 mei6 aa3? |
| Yale | néih sihk yùhn faahn meih a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄙㄧㆶ⁶ ㄩㄣ⁴ ㄈㄚㄣ⁶ ㄇㄝㄧ⁶ ㄚ³? |
| English | Have you finished eating? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **睇完呢套戲先瞓。** |
| Jyutping | tai2 jyun4 ni1 tou3 hei3 sin1 fan3. |
| Yale | tái yùhn nī tou hei sīn fan. |
| Bopomofo | ㄊㄜㄧ² ㄩㄣ⁴ ㄋㄧ¹ ㄊㄛㄨ³ ㄏㄝㄧ³ ㄙㄧㄣ¹ ㄈㄜㄣ³. |
| English | I'll go to bed when I've finished this film. |
